name: TiKV Distributed Key-Value Store
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source distributed transactional key-value database with RawKV and ACID transactional APIs; no software license fee or per-node free-edition quota.
watch_out: Self-managed TiKV requires your own servers, disks, network, backups, operations and often PD cluster components; infrastructure and any separately purchased managed TiDB/TiKV services cost extra. Use supported releases rather than assuming the development branch is production-ready.
